run_inference_e2e: run the BigVGAN inference script to generate WAV audio files from mel spectrogram inputs
load_checkpoint: load a BigVGAN generator checkpoint file and return the state dictionary on the specified device
scan_checkpoint: scan a checkpoint directory for the latest checkpoint file matching a given prefix
run_main_cli: run the BigVGAN inference CLI with input mel directory, output directory, and checkpoint file arguments
test_inference: test the BigVGAN inference function that converts mel spectrograms to waveform audio output
